Ewan Ross-Murray | Share on Facebook Share on X Add us as a preferred source England annihilated Croatia in the reverse fixture. | Michael Regan/The FA/Getty Images England can book its ticket to the UEFA Nations League quarterfinals on Thursday, but must overcome a Croatia team fueled by vengeance at Wembley Stadium. 
--> England can book its ticket to the UEFA Nations League quarterfinals on Thursday, but must overcome a Croatia team fueled by vengeance at Wembley Stadium. 
 The Three Lions know they must simply avoid defeat to qualify for the next round, although Thomas Tuchel will demand victory in order to set up a showdown with Spain for first place on Sunday. They’re currently three points behind the world champion following back-to-back victories over Czechia and their demolition of Croatia.

 Slaven Bilić’s return to the hot seat hardly went according to plan during the previous international break, with hefty defeats to Spain bookending an utterly embarrassing 7–0 loss to England . Harry Kane and Bukayo Saka both scored a brace to inflict a record-breaking loss on the 2018 World Cup finalists.
